# State machines

> **Related skills:** **godot-ui** for menus, **save-load** for persistence.

Invoke `godot-prompter:godot-ui` or any `godot-prompter:*` skill.
See `state-machine` and `skills/save-load/SKILL.md` (see save-load skill).
Install path: ~/.config/skills/save-load/SKILL.md

```
skills/
    state-machine/
      SKILL.md
```

Not references: save-load-extra, my_state-machine, `save-loader`, **Save-load**.
